subject: Post-call synthesis: buy-committee, evidence needs & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Jensen <maya.jensen@curelytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-19T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call synthesis: buy-committee, evidence needs & procurement timeline

Hi Maya — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick synthesis from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we heard (summary):
- Primary use case: clinical-notes summarization for QA team, replacing a homegrown pipeline.
- Key success criteria: 95% high-precision extraction of medication/events + <150ms p95 latency on batched inference for overnight ingest.
- Current evaluation: internal pilot demo next quarter; budget authority likely allocated in Q4.

Immediate asks you flagged:
1) Procurement timeline and required artifacts for SOW + PO (you mentioned procurement will process POs within ~3–4 weeks once scope & pricing are finalized).
2) Security evidence: SOC 2 report + data retention and deletion process documentation.
3) Contract reviewers: procurement contact + legal redline owner.

Our proposed actions (next steps we can take):
- Attach one-pager (attached) that maps solution capabilities to your acceptance criteria.
- Share SOC 2 evidence summary (attached) and a short checklist your security team can use.
- Schedule an intro call between Redwood engineering/security and your procurement/legal owners to unblock redlines.

Can you please:
- Share the names/emails of the procurement and legal reviewers (and whether procurement needs a specific PO template).
- Confirm the economic buyer / budget approver for this line item (title + best time to reach).

Proposed times for a 30-minute intro with your procurement/legal next week: Tue 8/26 10–11am PT, Wed 8/27 2–3pm PT, Thu 8/28 9–10am PT. If none work, shoot back a couple of windows.

Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf, procurement-timeline.xlsx, soc2-evidence-summary.pdf

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference  | Developer-first inference for production

From: Maya Jensen <maya.jensen@curelytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-19T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call synthesis: buy-committee, evidence needs & procurement timeline

Thanks Jordan — great recap and appreciate the attachments. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

Procurement & legal contacts (please loop these in):
- Daniel Park, Procurement Manager — daniel.park@curelytics.com
- Elena Morales, Counsel (Commercial Contracts) — elena.morales@curelytics.com

Economic buyer / approver:
- Chief Medical Officer, Dr. Priya Rao (will sign off on clinical risk and budget release). I can intro once we have a high-level cost estimate and SOW.

On security evidence: SOC 2 would be ideal — can you send the most recent report and a one-page summary that we can use for our InfoSec review? Also: sample data-handling SOPs and retention timelines.

Procurement timeline: We aim to have vendor selection complete by end of September. Procurement requires: final SOW, itemized pricing, redline-ready contract (we use your standard MSA as the starting point), and SOC 2. Daniel indicated PO processing typically takes 2–3 weeks after approvals.

Availability for the procurement/legal intro: Wed 8/27 2–3pm PT works for our team. Please send a calendar invite with a short agenda (20m intro, 10m Q&A).

Two quick asks for you before the meeting:
- Can you include a single-slide cost topline (monthly committed vs burst pricing) for the pilot?
- If possible, add a short note on fallback/availability guarantees for pilot data (how we’d handle outages/rollbacks).

Appreciate it — Maya
Maya Jensen
Director, Product Operations | Curelytics
maya.jensen@curelytics.com | +1 (617) 555-6642

Date: 2025-08-19T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call synthesis: buy-committee, evidence needs & procurement timeline

Thanks Maya — looping Daniel and Elena now. 

Short answers and attachments:
- SOC 2: attaching soc2-evidence-summary.pdf (redacted executive summary). If Daniel/Elena need the full report under NDA, happy to coordinate with our security team — let me know and I’ll route it.
- Cost topline: see the attached redwood-onepager.pdf (bottom section) — Ben, can you prepare a one-slide committed vs burst pricing snapshot and I’ll include it in the invite?
- Fallback / availability: Redwood offers automatic model fallback to a lower-cost variant + detailed runbooks for data replay; I’ve added a 2–3 bullet summary in the attached one-pager. We can expand that into an SLA bullet in the SOW.

Confirming Wed 2025-08-27 14:00–14:30 PT for the procurement/legal intro. I’ll send an invite with agenda and HubSpot deal link. 

Proposed agenda:
1) Intros (2m each)
2) Procurement & redline process (8m)
3) Security evidence and NDAs (8m)
4) Timeline & next steps (12m)

Ben — can you join the call and bring the pricing slide? Laura — would appreciate you joining for the legal/procurement handoff.

Thanks — Jordan

Attachments: soc2-evidence-summary.pdf, redwood-onepager.pdf, procurement-timeline.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call synthesis: buy-committee, evidence needs & procurement timeline

Internal note — forwarding the thread so you have context before the Wed intro. Highlights and asks for Ben/Laura: 

- Economic buyer: Dr. Priya Rao (CMO) — we’ll need a succinct executive email + topline cost to secure approval.
- Procurement wants SOW + itemized pricing + SOC 2; PO processing ~2–3 weeks after approvals.
- They confirmed Daniel Park (procurement) and Elena Morales (legal) as reviewers.

Ben: please draft the one-slide committed vs burst pricing and include a recommended pilot commitment level (tokens per month + expected unit cost). Also, outline any promotional credit we can offer to accelerate the pilot.
Laura: please prepare a short note on expected redline friction points (limitation of liability, data residency, termination for convenience) so we can preempt during the intro.

I’ll send the calendar invite in the next 10 minutes.

— Jordan
